asystole_pea.immediate_action: High-quality CPR immediately. 30 compressions to 2 breaths or continuous at 100-120 bpm.
asystole_pea.reversible_causes: Consider 5 Hs and 5 Ts: Hypovolemia, Hypoxia, Hydrogen ion (acidosis), Hypo/Hyperkalemia, Hypothermia; Tension pneumothorax, Tamponade, Toxins, Thrombosis (pulmonary), Thrombosis (coronary).

vf_pvt.immediate_action: Shock immediately: Biphasic 120-200 Joules (or manufacturer recommendation). Resume CPR immediately for 2 minutes without checking pulse.

medications.name: Epinephrine
medications.dose: 1 mg IV/IO after second shock, every 3 to 5 minutes

medications.name: Amiodarone
medications.dose: First dose 300 mg IV/IO bolus, second dose 150 mg IV/IO
